en: There was an error communicating with PECO. The issue that is most likely is that you entered an invalid phone number. Please check the phone number or try again later.
sv: Det uppstod ett kommunikationsfel med PECO. Du har troligen angett ett ogiltigt telefonnummer. Kontrollera telefonnumret eller försök igen senare.

en: The whole `platform: cloud` entry under the `tts:` section in configuration.yaml is deprecated and should be removed. You can use the UI to change settings for the Cloud text-to-speech platform. Please adjust your configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
